name: Paraty
tagline: Colonial cobbles, schooners and rainforest coast
summary: Paraty is a perfectly preserved Portuguese colonial town of whitewashed houses and huge cobblestones, between the Atlantic rainforest and a bay of islands. Take a schooner to island beaches, swim under waterfalls, visit cachaça distilleries, and hike to the wild beaches of Trindade.
seasonNote: Avoid the hottest, wettest months (December to February) if you can; high tides can flood the old streets.
arrival: About 4 hours by bus from Rio and 5 from São Paulo.
gettingAround: Walk the car-free historic centre; boats and buses for beaches.
cashTip: Cards and Pix work almost everywhere; carry some reais for beach vendors. A 10 percent service charge is usually added.
foodTip: Seafood moquecas, cachaça and the banana-based dishes of the coast.
